content.en: Ah! Veris! Haha, we meet again!
content.zh: 啊！何以真！哈哈，又见面了啊！

content.en: Page? Right, Jinlan Temple is just ahead. Are you working here?
content.zh: 周书？对了，前面是金兰观来着。你是在工作吗？

content.en: Yep! I’m in charge of holding people here and only letting everyone in once the awards officially begin.
content.zh: 对啊！我负责在这里拦着人，等到颁奖正式开始的时候再放大家进去。

content.en: I see... well, I’ll secretly let you through, hehe~ All the performers are waiting up front for the awards anyway. Letting just you in won’t get me scolded by Master.
content.zh: 这样啊......那我偷偷放你过去吧嘿嘿嘿~反正表演人员都在前面等颁奖，只放你一个进去师父肯定也不会骂我的。

content.en: Ah! Veris! Haha, we meet again!
content.zh: 啊！何以真！哈哈，又见面了啊！

content.en: Thanks. If you’re free this afternoon, want to go look around together?
content.zh: 谢了，下午有空了要不要一起去逛逛？

content.en: Sure! My shift ends around noon anyway! I’m telling you, there’s so much good food around Yuntai!
content.zh: 好啊！我的工作正好到中午就结束了！我跟你说啊，芸台这边可多好吃的了！

content.en: Then it’s a deal. I’ll head ahead first—see you later, Page.
content.zh: 那就说定了。我先去前面了，晚点再见，周书。

content.en: Mm! I’ll be heading over for the awards too. See you in a bit!
content.zh: 嗯！待会儿颁奖我也会过去的，一会儿见啦！
